pipelines.name: Bump a dependency

steps.run:
set -euxo pipefail

if [ "$VERSION" = latest ]; then
  VERSION="$(curl -sL https://pypi.org/pypi/$PACKAGE/json | jq -r .info.version)"
fi

git checkout -b "bot/bump-version/$PACKAGE/$VERSION"

python3 -S -m tools.bump_version "$PACKAGE" "$VERSION"

re="$(sed 's/[_-]/[_-]/g' <<< "$PACKAGE")"

# Update Cargo.toml dependencies (format: package = "version")
sed -i "s/^\($re\) = \"[^\"]*\"/\1 = \"$VERSION\"/g" -- rust_snuba/Cargo.toml
# Also handle dependencies with features (format: package = { version = "version", features = [...] })
sed -i "s/^\($re\) = { version = \"[^\"]*\"/\1 = { version = \"$VERSION\"/g" -- rust_snuba/Cargo.toml

# Update Cargo.lock if Cargo.toml was modified
if ! git diff --exit-code -- rust_snuba/Cargo.toml > /dev/null 2>&1; then
  cd rust_snuba
  # Try updating with underscores (cargo prefers underscores in package names)
  CARGO_PACKAGE="$(echo "$PACKAGE" | sed 's/-/_/g')"
  if ! cargo update --package "$CARGO_PACKAGE" 2>/dev/null; then
    # If that fails, try with the original package name
    cargo update --package "$PACKAGE"
  fi
  cd ..
fi

if git diff --exit-code; then
  exit 0
fi

git \
    -c user.name=getsentry-bot \
    -c user.email='10587625+getsentry-bot@users.noreply.github.com' \
    commit \
    --all \
    --message "ref: bump $PACKAGE to $VERSION" \
    --message "Co-Authored-By: $SENDER <$SENDER_ID+$SENDER@users.noreply.github.com>"

git push origin HEAD --quiet

gh pr create --fill

# Test that the script can be imported and shows help

steps.name: Install Rust Toolchain
steps.run:
rustup toolchain install stable --profile minimal --no-self-update
rustup component add clippy rustfmt --toolchain stable

steps.name: Log in to GHCR for build cache
Load and pull Docker dependency images
steps.run:
if [ -f /tmp/docker-deps/deps.tar ]; then
  docker load --input /tmp/docker-deps/deps.tar
fi
images=(
  "ghcr.io/getsentry/image-mirror-altinity-clickhouse-server:25.8.33.10002.altinitystable"
  "ghcr.io/getsentry/image-mirror-confluentinc-cp-kafka:7.5.0"
  "ghcr.io/getsentry/image-mirror-valkey-valkey:8.0.12"
)
pulled=0
for image in "${images[@]}"; do
  if ! docker image inspect "$image" &>/dev/null; then
    docker pull "$image"
    pulled=1
  fi
done
if [ "$pulled" -eq 1 ]; then
  mkdir -p /tmp/docker-deps
  docker save "${images[@]}" -o /tmp/docker-deps/deps.tar
fi
echo "pulled=$pulled" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

steps.name: Compute Rust test build cache key
steps.run:
rustc=$(docker run --rm --user root --entrypoint rustc -w /usr/src/snuba/rust_snuba \
  ghcr.io/getsentry/snuba-ci:${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }} -vV | sed -n 's/^commit-hash: //p')
echo "prefix=rust-test-target-${{ runner.arch }}-${rustc}-" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "key=rust-test-target-${{ runner.arch }}-${rustc}-${{ hashFiles('rust_snuba/Cargo.lock') }}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

admin-tests.name: Front end tests for snuba admin

steps.name: Set up and run tests through yarn
steps.run: cd snuba/admin && yarn install && yarn run test --coverage

steps.name: Setup steps
steps.run:
# We cannot execute actions that are not placed under .github of the main repo
mkdir -p .github/actions
cp -r sentry/.github/actions/* .github/actions

steps.name: Start snuba
steps.run:
# TODO(hubertdeng123): New devservices doesn't support running sentry without snuba yet, remove this when it does
docker stop snuba-snuba-1
docker rm snuba-snuba-1
docker run -d --rm \
  -p 127.0.0.1:1218:1218 \
  -e PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 \
  -e SNUBA_SETTINGS=docker \
  -e DEBUG=1 \
  -e DEFAULT_BROKERS=kafka:9093 \
  -e CLICKHOUSE_HOST=clickhouse \
  -e CLICKHOUSE_HTTP_PORT=8123 \
  -e REDIS_HOST=redis \
  -e REDIS_PORT=6379 \
  -e REDIS_DB=1 \
  --name snuba-snuba-1 \
  --network devservices \
  ghcr.io/getsentry/snuba-ci:${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
docker exec snuba-snuba-1 snuba migrations migrate --force

steps.name: Run full tests
steps.run:
export PYTEST_ADDOPTS="$PYTEST_ADDOPTS -k 'not __In' -m 'snuba and not snuba_ci' -n $XDIST_WORKERS --dist=loadfile -vv"
make test-python-ci

steps.name: Load Docker dependency images
steps.run:
if [ -f /tmp/docker-deps/deps.tar ]; then
  docker load --input /tmp/docker-deps/deps.tar
fi
images=(
  "ghcr.io/getsentry/image-mirror-${{ matrix.version }}"
  "ghcr.io/getsentry/image-mirror-confluentinc-cp-kafka:7.5.0"
  "ghcr.io/getsentry/image-mirror-valkey-valkey:8.0.12"
)
for image in "${images[@]}"; do
  if ! docker image inspect "$image" &>/dev/null; then
    docker pull "$image"
  fi
done

steps.name: Docker Snuba Test other ClickHouse versions
steps.run:
export CLICKHOUSE_IMAGE=ghcr.io/getsentry/image-mirror-${{matrix.version}}
SNUBA_IMAGE=ghcr.io/getsentry/snuba-ci:${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }} SNUBA_SETTINGS=test docker compose -f docker-compose.gcb.yml run --rm ${{ matrix.test_type }}

steps.name: Verify Python imports
steps.run:
docker run --rm --entrypoint python3 snuba:test \
  -c "import snuba, rust_snuba, confluent_kafka; print('OK')"

steps.name: Verify jemalloc LD_PRELOAD is active
steps.run:
docker run --rm --entrypoint python3 snuba:test \
  -c "import ctypes; ctypes.CDLL('libjemalloc.so.2'); print('jemalloc OK')"

steps.name: Verify no shell available
steps.run:
# This should fail — the production image has no /bin/sh
if docker run --rm --entrypoint /bin/sh snuba:test -c "echo hi" 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "ERROR: /bin/sh should not be available in the production image"
  exit 1
else
  echo "OK: /bin/sh is not available"
fi
